### Exercice - cercle de Mohr interactif

::: {.mohr-panel}
**Tenseur des contraintes** (MPa) : tapez une valeur ou déplacez le curseur.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof sxx = Inputs.range([-300, 300], {value: 40, step: 1, label: html`σ<sub>xx</sub>`})
viewof syy = Inputs.range([-300, 300], {value: -40, step: 1, label: html`σ<sub>yy</sub>`})
viewof sxy = Inputs.range([-300, 300], {value: 30, step: 1, label: html`σ<sub>xy</sub>`})
```
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
c = (sxx + syy) / 2
R = Math.sqrt(((sxx - syy) / 2) ** 2 + sxy ** 2)
s1 = c + R
s2 = c - R
theta = 0.5 * Math.atan2(2 * sxy, sxx - syy)
thetaDeg = theta * 180 / Math.PI
e1 = [Math.cos(theta), Math.sin(theta)]
e2 = [-Math.sin(theta), Math.cos(theta)]
couleurs = ({bleu: "#3b6ea5", orange: "#d98c2b", violet: "#7b5ea7", gris: "#8a94a0"})
```

#### Cercle de Mohr

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const deg = Math.PI / 180;
  const cercle = d3.range(0, 361).map(a => ({s: c + R * Math.cos(a * deg), t: R * Math.sin(a * deg)}));
  const angX = Math.atan2(-sxy, sxx - c);
  const arc = d3.range(0, 41).map(i => {
    const a = angX * i / 40;
    return {s: c + 0.3 * R * Math.cos(a), t: 0.3 * R * Math.sin(a)};
  });
  const X = {s: sxx, t: -sxy, label: "X"};
  const Y = {s: syy, t: sxy, label: "Y"};
  const P = [{s: s1, t: 0, label: `σI = ${s1.toFixed(1)}`, dx: 6, anchor: "start"},
             {s: s2, t: 0, label: `σII = ${s2.toFixed(1)}`, dx: -6, anchor: "end"}];
  const T = [{s: c, t: R, label: "τmax"}, {s: c, t: -R, label: ""}];
  const m = Math.max(R, 1) * 1.45;
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 420, height: 420,
    x: {domain: [c - m, c + m], label: "σn (MPa) →"},
    y: {domain: [-m, m], label: "↑ τn (MPa)"},
    grid: true,
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: couleurs.gris}),
      Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: couleurs.gris, clip: true}),
      Plot.line(cercle, {x: "s", y: "t", stroke: couleurs.bleu, strokeWidth: 3}),
      Plot.line([X, Y], {x: "s", y: "t", stroke: couleurs.gris, strokeDasharray: "5,4"}),
      Plot.line(arc, {x: "s", y: "t", stroke: couleurs.orange, strokeWidth: 2}),
      Plot.text([{s: c + 0.42 * R * Math.cos(angX / 2), t: 0.42 * R * Math.sin(angX / 2)}],
                {x: "s", y: "t", text: () => "2θ", fill: couleurs.orange, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "bold"}),
      Plot.dot([{s: c, t: 0}], {x: "s", y: "t", r: 4, fill: "white", stroke: "currentColor"}),
      Plot.dot(T, {x: "s", y: "t", r: 4, fill: couleurs.violet}),
      Plot.text(T, {x: "s", y: "t", text: "label", dy: -12, fill: couleurs.violet, fontSize: 12}),
      Plot.dot([X, Y], {x: "s", y: "t", r: 5, fill: "currentColor"}),
      Plot.text([X, Y], {x: "s", y: "t", text: "label", dx: 9, dy: -9, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "bold"}),
      Plot.dot(P, {x: "s", y: "t", r: 6, fill: couleurs.orange}),
      Plot.text(P, {x: "s", y: "t", text: "label", dx: "dx", dy: 14, textAnchor: "anchor",
                    fill: couleurs.orange, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "bold"})
    ]
  });
}
```

#### Directions principales

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const r2 = Math.SQRT1_2;
  const t1 = [r2 * (e1[0] + e2[0]), r2 * (e1[1] + e2[1])];   // cisaillement max (+45°)
  const t2 = [r2 * (e1[0] - e2[0]), r2 * (e1[1] - e2[1])];   // cisaillement max (−45°)
  const smax = Math.max(Math.abs(s1), Math.abs(s2), 1e-9);

  const axe = (n) => [{x: -1.7 * n[0], y: -1.7 * n[1]}, {x: 1.7 * n[0], y: 1.7 * n[1]}];
  // flèches depuis l'origine : sortantes en traction, rentrantes en compression
  const fleches = (n, s) => [1, -1].map(k => {
    const L = 0.35 + 0.75 * Math.abs(s) / smax;
    const p = [k * 0.1 * n[0], k * 0.1 * n[1]];
    const q = [k * L * n[0], k * L * n[1]];
    return s >= 0 ? {x1: p[0], y1: p[1], x2: q[0], y2: q[1]}
                  : {x1: q[0], y1: q[1], x2: p[0], y2: p[1]};
  });
  const arcT = d3.range(0, 31).map(i => ({x: 0.3 * Math.cos(theta * i / 30),
                                          y: 0.3 * Math.sin(theta * i / 30)}));
  const lab = (n, txt, col) => ({x: 1.5 * n[0], y: 1.5 * n[1], t: txt, col});

  return Plot.plot({
    width: 420, height: 420,
    x: {domain: [-1.7, 1.7], label: "x →"},
    y: {domain: [-1.7, 1.7], label: "↑ y"},
    grid: true,
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: couleurs.gris}), Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: couleurs.gris}),
      Plot.line(axe(e1), {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: couleurs.orange, strokeWidth: 1.5}),
      Plot.line(axe(e2), {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: couleurs.bleu, strokeWidth: 1.5}),
      Plot.line(axe(t1), {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: couleurs.violet, strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "6,4"}),
      Plot.line(axe(t2), {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: couleurs.violet, strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "6,4"}),
      Plot.arrow(fleches(e1, s1), {x1: "x1", y1: "y1", x2: "x2", y2: "y2",
                 stroke: couleurs.orange, strokeWidth: 3, headLength: 10}),
      Plot.arrow(fleches(e2, s2), {x1: "x1", y1: "y1", x2: "x2", y2: "y2",
                 stroke: couleurs.bleu, strokeWidth: 3, headLength: 10}),
      Plot.line(arcT, {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: "currentColor", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
      Plot.text([{x: 0.42 * Math.cos(theta / 2), y: 0.42 * Math.sin(theta / 2)}],
                {x: "x", y: "y", text: () => "θp", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "bold"}),
      Plot.text([lab(e1, `I · σI = ${s1.toFixed(1)}`, couleurs.orange),
                 lab(e2, `II · σII = ${s2.toFixed(1)}`, couleurs.bleu),
                 lab(t1, "τmax", couleurs.violet),
                 lab(t2, "τmax", couleurs.violet)],
                {x: "x", y: "y", text: "t", fill: "col", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "bold"})
    ]
  });
}
```
:::
::::

Les droites pleines sont les directions principales (flèches sortantes : traction, rentrantes : compression). Les droites violettes en pointillés sont les directions de cisaillement maximal, à 45° des directions principales.

### Exercice - rosette de déformation

Une rosette est composée de trois jauges collées selon les angles θ<sub>a</sub>,
θ<sub>b</sub> et θ<sub>c</sub>, mesurés depuis l'axe x.

::: {.mohr-panel}
**Rosette** : angles des jauges (°) et déformations mesurées (µm/m).

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof rTa = Inputs.range([0, 180], {value: 0,  step: 5, label: html`θ<sub>a</sub> (°)`})
viewof rTb = Inputs.range([0, 180], {value: 45, step: 5, label: html`θ<sub>b</sub> (°)`})
viewof rTc = Inputs.range([0, 180], {value: 90, step: 5, label: html`θ<sub>c</sub> (°)`})
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof rEa = Inputs.range([-3000, 3000], {value: 600,  step: 10, label: html`ε<sub>a</sub> (µm/m)`})
viewof rEb = Inputs.range([-3000, 3000], {value: 400,  step: 10, label: html`ε<sub>b</sub> (µm/m)`})
viewof rEc = Inputs.range([-3000, 3000], {value: -200, step: 10, label: html`ε<sub>c</sub> (µm/m)`})
```
:::
::::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const W = 760, H = 290, cx = W / 2, cy = 255;
  const jauges = [
    {n: "a", t: rTa, e: rEa, col: "#3d8b5f", r: 48},
    {n: "b", t: rTb, e: rEb, col: "#b5487a", r: 64},
    {n: "c", t: rTc, e: rEc, col: "#4a8fa8", r: 80}
  ];
  const P = (r, t) => [cx + r * Math.cos(t * rDeg), cy - r * Math.sin(t * rDeg)];

  let grille = "M 100 -10";
  for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
    const y = -10 + 4 * k, xb = k % 2 === 0 ? 165 : 100;
    grille += ` L ${xb} ${y}` + (k < 5 ? ` L ${xb} ${y + 4}` : "");
  }

  let s = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" style="width:100%; max-width:${W}px; display:block;
             margin: 0.5rem auto 0.8rem; font-family: inherit;">
    <defs>
      <marker id="rfleche" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto">
        <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#8a94a0"/>
      </marker>
    </defs>
    <line x1="${cx - 240}" y1="${cy}" x2="${cx + 240}" y2="${cy}" stroke="#8a94a0" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#rfleche)"/>
    <line x1="${cx}" y1="${cy + 10}" x2="${cx}" y2="${cy - 240}" stroke="#8a94a0" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#rfleche)"/>
    <text x="${cx + 243}" y="${cy + 18}" fill="#6b7785" font-size="15" font-style="italic">x</text>
    <text x="${cx + 10}" y="${cy - 230}" fill="#6b7785" font-size="15" font-style="italic">y</text>`;

  for (const j of jauges) {
    if (j.t > 0) {
      const [xe, ye] = P(j.r, j.t);
      const [xl, yl] = P(j.r + 11, j.t / 2);
      s += `<path d="M ${cx + j.r} ${cy} A ${j.r} ${j.r} 0 0 0 ${xe} ${ye}"
              fill="none" stroke="${j.col}" stroke-width="2"/>
            <text x="${xl}" y="${yl}" fill="${j.col}" font-size="12" font-weight="bold"
              text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">θ${j.n}</text>`;
    }
    s += `<g transform="translate(${cx},${cy}) rotate(${-j.t})">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="92" y2="0" stroke="${j.col}" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
      <rect x="92" y="-17" width="82" height="34" rx="5" fill="${j.col}" fill-opacity="0.12"
            stroke="${j.col}" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <path d="${grille}" fill="none" stroke="${j.col}" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <rect x="174" y="-11" width="11" height="8" rx="2" fill="${j.col}"/>
      <rect x="174" y="3"   width="11" height="8" rx="2" fill="${j.col}"/>
    </g>`;
    const [xt, yt] = P(205, j.t);
    const c = Math.cos(j.t * rDeg);
    const anchor = c > 0.25 ? "start" : c < -0.25 ? "end" : "middle";
    s += `<text x="${xt}" y="${yt}" fill="${j.col}" font-size="13" font-weight="bold"
            text-anchor="${anchor}" dominant-baseline="middle">
            ${j.n} · ${j.t}° · ${j.e} µm/m</text>`;
  }

  s += `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="4" fill="#2b3a4a"/></svg>`;
  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.innerHTML = s;
  return div;
}
```
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
rDeg = Math.PI / 180
rRow = t => [Math.cos(t * rDeg) ** 2, Math.sin(t * rDeg) ** 2,
             Math.sin(t * rDeg) * Math.cos(t * rDeg)]
rDet = M => M[0][0] * (M[1][1] * M[2][2] - M[1][2] * M[2][1])
          - M[0][1] * (M[1][0] * M[2][2] - M[1][2] * M[2][0])
          + M[0][2] * (M[1][0] * M[2][1] - M[1][1] * M[2][0])
rSol = {
  const A = [rRow(rTa), rRow(rTb), rRow(rTc)];
  const b = [rEa, rEb, rEc];
  const D = rDet(A);
  if (Math.abs(D) < 1e-6) return null;       // jauges parallèles : système non résoluble
  const col = k => A.map((r, i) => r.map((v, j) => (j === k ? b[i] : v)));
  return {exx: rDet(col(0)) / D, eyy: rDet(col(1)) / D, gxy: rDet(col(2)) / D};
}
rOK    = rSol !== null
rS     = rSol ?? {exx: 0, eyy: 0, gxy: 0}
rC     = (rS.exx + rS.eyy) / 2                          // centre du cercle
rR     = Math.hypot((rS.exx - rS.eyy) / 2, rS.gxy / 2)  // rayon (en ε)
rE1    = rC + rR
rE2    = rC - rR
rGmax  = 2 * rR                                         // distorsion maximale
rTh    = 0.5 * Math.atan2(rS.gxy, rS.exx - rS.eyy)
rThDeg = rTh / rDeg
// point du cercle (ε_n, γ_n) associé à une direction θ
// même convention que l'exercice précédent : la facette x est en (ε_xx, −γ_xy)
rPt = t => {
  const a = 2 * t * rDeg;
  return {s: rC + (rS.exx - rS.eyy) / 2 * Math.cos(a) + rS.gxy / 2 * Math.sin(a),
          t: (rS.exx - rS.eyy) * Math.sin(a) - rS.gxy * Math.cos(a)};
}
rCol = ({bleu: "#3b6ea5", orange: "#d98c2b", violet: "#7b5ea7",
         vert: "#3d8b5f", gris: "#8a94a0"})
```



<details class="mohr-reveal">
<summary>Afficher les résultats</summary>

Chaque jauge mesure l'allongement dans sa direction :

$$
\varepsilon(\theta) = \varepsilon_{xx}\cos^2\theta + \varepsilon_{yy}\sin^2\theta
+ \gamma_{xy}\sin\theta\cos\theta
$$

Les trois mesures donnent un système de trois équations dont les inconnues sont
ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε<sub>yy</sub> et γ<sub>xy</sub>. On en déduit ensuite le cercle
de Mohr des déformations et les directions principales.

#### Cercle de Mohr des déformations

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  if (!rOK) return html`<p><em>Choisissez trois directions de jauges différentes.</em></p>`;
  const cercle = d3.range(0, 361).map(a => ({s: rC + rR * Math.cos(a * rDeg),
                                             t: 2 * rR * Math.sin(a * rDeg)}));
  const jauges = [["a", rTa], ["b", rTb], ["c", rTc]].map(([n, t]) => ({...rPt(t), label: n}));
  const X = {...rPt(0), label: "X"};
  const Y = {...rPt(90), label: "Y"};
  const P = [{s: rE1, t: 0, label: `εI = ${rE1.toFixed(0)}`, dx: 6, anchor: "start"},
             {s: rE2, t: 0, label: `εII = ${rE2.toFixed(0)}`, dx: -6, anchor: "end"}];
  const G = [{s: rC, t: rGmax, label: "γmax"}, {s: rC, t: -rGmax, label: ""}];
  const m = Math.max(rR, 1) * 1.5;
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 420, height: 420,
    x: {domain: [rC - m, rC + m], label: "εn (µm/m) →"},
    y: {domain: [-2 * m, 2 * m], label: "↑ γn (µm/m)"},
    grid: true,
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: rCol.gris}),
      Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: rCol.gris, clip: true}),
      Plot.line(cercle, {x: "s", y: "t", stroke: rCol.bleu, strokeWidth: 3}),
      Plot.line([X, Y], {x: "s", y: "t", stroke: rCol.gris, strokeDasharray: "5,4"}),
      Plot.dot([X, Y], {x: "s", y: "t", r: 5, fill: "currentColor"}),
      Plot.text([X, Y], {x: "s", y: "t", text: "label", dx: 9, dy: -9, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "bold"}),
      Plot.dot(G, {x: "s", y: "t", r: 4, fill: rCol.violet}),
      Plot.text(G, {x: "s", y: "t", text: "label", dy: -12, fill: rCol.violet, fontSize: 12}),
      Plot.dot(jauges, {x: "s", y: "t", r: 6, fill: rCol.vert, stroke: "white"}),
      Plot.text(jauges, {x: "s", y: "t", text: "label", dx: -10, dy: -10,
                         fill: rCol.vert, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "bold"}),
      Plot.dot([{s: rC, t: 0}], {x: "s", y: "t", r: 4, fill: "white", stroke: "currentColor"}),
      Plot.dot(P, {x: "s", y: "t", r: 6, fill: rCol.orange}),
      Plot.text(P, {x: "s", y: "t", text: "label", dx: "dx", dy: 14, textAnchor: "anchor",
                    fill: rCol.orange, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "bold"})
    ]
  });
}
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
#### Rosette et directions principales

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  if (!rOK) return html`<p><em>Choisissez trois directions de jauges différentes.</em></p>`;
  const dir = t => [Math.cos(t * rDeg), Math.sin(t * rDeg)];
  const seg = (n, L) => [{x: -L * n[0], y: -L * n[1]}, {x: L * n[0], y: L * n[1]}];
  const jauges = [["a", rTa, rEa], ["b", rTb, rEb], ["c", rTc, rEc]];
  const e1 = dir(rThDeg), e2 = dir(rThDeg + 90);
  const marks = [
    Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: rCol.gris}), Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: rCol.gris}),
    Plot.line(seg(e1, 1.6), {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: rCol.orange, strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "7,4"}),
    Plot.line(seg(e2, 1.6), {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: rCol.bleu, strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "7,4"}),
    Plot.text([{x: 1.45 * e1[0], y: 1.45 * e1[1], t: "I"}],
              {x: "x", y: "y", text: "t", fill: rCol.orange, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: "bold", dy: -10}),
    Plot.text([{x: 1.45 * e2[0], y: 1.45 * e2[1], t: "II"}],
              {x: "x", y: "y", text: "t", fill: rCol.bleu, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: "bold", dy: -10})
  ];
  for (const [n, t, e] of jauges) {
    const u = dir(t);
    marks.push(
      Plot.line(seg(u, 0.85), {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: rCol.vert, strokeWidth: 9, strokeOpacity: 0.25}),
      Plot.line(seg(u, 0.85), {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: rCol.vert, strokeWidth: 2}),
      Plot.text([{x: 1.12 * u[0], y: 1.12 * u[1], t: `${n} : ${e} µm/m`}],
                {x: "x", y: "y", text: "t", fill: rCol.vert, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "bold"})
    );
  }
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 420, height: 420,
    x: {domain: [-1.7, 1.7], label: "x →"},
    y: {domain: [-1.7, 1.7], label: "↑ y"},
    grid: true,
    marks
  });
}
```
:::
::::

Les points verts a, b et c sont les trois jauges : sur le cercle de Mohr, deux
jauges séparées d'un angle α dans la rosette sont séparées de 2α sur le cercle.
Les droites en pointillés sont les directions principales I et II.
